name: Super Shortcuts
soft_passes: #5 flat: consistent light model only by absence, no lighting/dimensionality
#8 no depth system to be incoherent; single plane + glyph
#11 lightning bolt is nameable but the automation-category cliche, not a mined device
failures: #1 mask: ships pre-masked 434px rounded-rect with 7.4% transparent margin in a 512 canvas (not full-bleed); baked ~20% corner radius won't match system squircle ~22.4%
#10 variant robustness: flat raster, baked colours, no mono/layer separation; no dark/clear/tinted adaptation, not Icon-Composer authored
light_model: None. Flat design: no light source, no baked shadow, no specular, zero dimensionality. Consistent only by absence.
layer_stack: flat green field baked into a rounded-rect with transparent corner margins
devices: lightning-bolt-as-automation (category-default speed metaphor, Apple Shortcuts lineage)
baked rounded-rect favicon mask transplanted onto a Mac icon
rhymes_hint: flat single-glyph-on-solid-color brandmarks (favicon/app-tile grade, no-era flat family); automation/productivity icons using the lightning-bolt speed metaphor
notes: 512x512 delivered, NOT the 1024 master; crisp vector-origin edges. Background genuinely flat (17,890 identical samples). Glyph optically centred: dx +7 (bolt tilt), dy 0; bolt 214x352 = ~81% field height. Contrast white/green 3.44:1 (clears 3:1 graphics floor, below 4.5:1). Opaque field 38-472 both axes = pre-masked rounded-rect, corners baked into artwork with transparent margins -> the core reason it is not macOS-native. No dark/tinted variant available. Era tag is a bucketing convenience: this is really a platform-agnostic flat web brandmark, not period-accurate Yosemite-Catalina evidence; do not treat as macOS-era canon input. Brand coherence: cover reuses green family on near-black #0C120E ground (mint headline #5FD08D, cover icon tile ~#26B16B) but marketing greens are brighter/more saturated than the shipped icon's muted teal-leaning #1F9D6F -> mild palette drift, exact green not locked.
